metadata.criterion: Can select keyed answer from printed teaching/illustration and ordinary application. Does not mean every clause of a keyed answer or every distractor explanation is taught.

status_definitions.covered: Printed teaching/illustration supplies keyed-answer selection or required principle/formula; retained rounding qualifications apply.
status_definitions.not_covered: Exact required illustration or knowledge missing.
status_definitions.prompt_only: Supplied numbers/formulas permit arithmetic, but the book does not teach this method/model.

metadata.page_numbering: One-based physical PDF pages including cover; continuous printed folios and PDF labels verified in H6. Original bank page field is unrelated.
